map.CIDR 用「IP/前缀长度」表示一段连续地址。本工具解析后给出该网段的网络地址: CIDR uses "IP/prefix length" to denote a contiguous block of addresses. This tool parses it and returns the network address, broadcast address, and the range and count of usable hosts — handy for subnet planning and checking firewall rules.
map.在 IPv4 起止地址与 CIDR 列表之间展开或聚合。: Expand or aggregate between IPv4 start-end ranges and CIDR lists.
map.：IPv4 可视为 32 位无符号整数，地址范围即整数区间，展开即逐个递增。: : an IPv4 address is a 32-bit unsigned integer, so a range is an interval of integers and expanding it simply counts upward.
map.：把连续区间合并为最少的 CIDR 块，需按块大小对齐边界。: : merge contiguous ranges into the fewest CIDR blocks, aligning boundaries to the block size.
map.：大范围展开会产生海量条目，应优先用 CIDR 聚合表示。: : expanding a large range produces an enormous list, so prefer expressing it as aggregated CIDRs.
map.：批量地址清单生成、防火墙与路由规则整理。: : generating address lists in bulk, and tidying firewall and routing rules.
map.子网掩码由前缀决定：/24 即 255.255.255.0，前 24 位为网络位: The subnet mask follows from the prefix: /24 means 255.255.255.0, with the first 24 bits as the network part and the last 8 as the host part.
map.网络地址 = IP 与掩码按位与；广播地址 = 网络地址或上掩码取反；可用主机: Network address = IP AND mask; broadcast address = network address OR the inverted mask; usable hosts = total − 2 (excluding the network and broadcast addresses).
map./31、/32 是特殊用途（链路/单主机），可用主机数为 0，本工具已单独提示。: /31 and /32 are special cases (link / single host) with 0 usable hosts, and this tool flags them separately.
map.把 192.168.1.1-192.168.1.10 之类的范围展开为列表。: Expand a range such as 192.168.1.1-192.168.1.10 into a list.
map.批量生成待扫描或待配置的 IP 列表：把连续的段展开成逐行文本，直接喂给脚本或防: Generating a list of IPs to scan or configure in bulk: expand a contiguous block into line-by-line text you can feed straight to a script or firewall config.
map.跨段范围能展开吗？: Can a range spanning several subnets be expanded?
map.可以，但地址数极大时建议只取首尾或按需分页。: Yes, but when the address count is huge, take just the endpoints or paginate as needed.
map.范围很大时会卡吗？: Will a very large range freeze the page?
map.会。一个 /8 有 1600 多万个地址，完整展开会耗尽内存、浏览器也会失去响应: Yes. A /8 holds more than 16 million addresses; expanding it fully exhausts memory and the browser stops responding. Prefer expressing the range in CIDR, expand only when you genuinely need per-address handling, and set a count cap as a safeguard; for bulk work, favour subnet rules over an IP-by-IP list.
